args.sql:
SELECT r.investmentref, r.alpha3y, r.beta3y, r.avgreturn3y, r.volatility3y, f.expensenet, f.benchmarkexp 
FROM risk_metrics r 
JOIN funds f ON r.investmentref = f.tickersym 
WHERE r.volatility3y > 0 AND r.avgreturn3y IS NOT NULL
LIMIT 10;

WITH amv_calc AS (
    SELECT 
        f.tickersym,
        r.avgreturn3y,
        r.volatility3y,
        r.alpha3y,
        f.expensenet,
        f.benchmarkexp,
        -- Relative Expense Ratio
        COALESCE(f.expensenet - f.benchmarkexp, 0) AS relative_expense,
        -- Information Ratio (using alpha as excess return)
        CASE WHEN r.volatility3y > 0 THEN r.alpha3y / r.volatility3y ELSE NULL END AS info_ratio,
        -- Active Manager Value
        CASE WHEN r.volatility3y > 0 THEN 
            (r.alpha3y / r.volatility3y) - (COALESCE(f.expensenet - f.benchmarkexp, 0) * 10)
        ELSE NULL END AS amv
    FROM risk_metrics r
    JOIN funds f ON r.investmentref = f.tickersym
    WHERE r.avgreturn3y IS NOT NULL AND r.volatility3y > 0
)
SELECT tickersym, amv, info_ratio, relative_expense
FROM amv_calc
ORDER BY amv DESC
LIMIT 20;

WITH amv_calc AS (
    SELECT 
        f.tickersym,
        CASE WHEN r.volatility3y > 0 THEN 
            (r.alpha3y / r.volatility3y) - (COALESCE(f.expensenet - f.benchmarkexp, 0) * 10)
        ELSE NULL END AS amv
    FROM risk_metrics r
    JOIN funds f ON r.investmentref = f.tickersym
    WHERE r.avgreturn3y IS NOT NULL AND r.volatility3y > 0
)
SELECT 
    COUNT(*) as total_funds,
    SUM(CASE WHEN amv > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as positive_count,
    ROUND(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN amv > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS numeric) / COUNT(*), 4) as positive_portion
FROM amv_calc;

WITH amv_calc AS (
    SELECT 
        f.tickersym,

            ROUND(CAST(
                (r.alpha3y / r.volatility3y) - (COALESCE(f.expensenet - f.benchmarkexp, 0) * 10)
            AS numeric), 4)
        ELSE NULL END AS manager_value_score
    FROM risk_metrics r
    JOIN funds f ON r.investmentref = f.tickersym
    WHERE r.avgreturn3y IS NOT NULL AND r.volatility3y > 0
),
total_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        ROUND(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN manager_value_score > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS numeric) / COUNT(*), 4) as positive_portion
    FROM amv_calc
)
SELECT

    t.positive_portion
FROM amv_calc a, total_stats t

ORDER BY a.manager_value_score DESC;

) sub
